title: A Protocol for the Extraction
author: Sebastian Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Vane, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
